units.en: As Australia, own all core territory of Hungary.

As an aside, none of the strategies on this page work with ⟦0⟧ enabled. With it enabled, all of the countries in the region will just join the ⟦1⟧ when you attack them and pull ⟦2⟧ into the conflict. You can still complete this achievement this way, but if you do, the game will be very long because ⟦3⟧ gets additional cores via their focus tree after they carve up ⟦4⟧. This means you'll have to invade ⟦5⟧ after the ⟦6⟧ has been defeated usually (because those cores are starting states of ⟦7⟧), which probably mean dealing with the ⟦8⟧. Basically, disable ⟦9⟧ or this achievement's difficulty goes from "Easy" to "Hard".
⟦0⟧ must be disabled for this strategy to work. ⟦1⟧ must be enabled, since we're using its focus tree.

This method is significantly easier than the other methods, as Australia's starting position is substantially improved in ⟦0⟧. They get a third research slot from the beginning, their focuses are much more powerful, and increasing your conscription laws is much easier. This strategy also ensures you will get ⟦1⟧ along the way.

Change your occupation law to Civilian Oversight. Convert all your starting forces to the Infantry division template and add a naval queue for Convoys. Do ⟦0⟧ followed by ⟦1⟧. Afterwards, hire the following three advisors in order: ⟦2⟧, ⟦3⟧, and ⟦4⟧. Build 2 ⟦5⟧ and 5 ⟦6⟧ in Queensland and pump out ⟦7⟧ for the rest of the game after that.

Next do ⟦0⟧ and ⟦1⟧. Grab the Bradmill Denim Factory Industrial Concern and then do ⟦2⟧ followed by ⟦3⟧. Take the decision to "Seize Local Leadership in New South Wales" and do the focus ⟦4⟧. You should be able to do the focus for ⟦5⟧ immediately afterwards, though you might have to wait a couple days. When it finishes, pick up Ideological Loyalty for your Spirit of the Army. Use any remaining ⟦6⟧ to add in Support Artillery and Infantry Guns, along with one more Infantry battalion to even out the regiments. Use your ⟦7⟧ to promote John Northcott to a Field Marshal and assign him as your Field Marshal with Leslie Morshead as your General.

Doing all of this lets you convert to ⟦0⟧ by the end of 1936 without triggering the civil war, and you get a free bypass on ⟦1⟧, which was blocking off your economic path focuses. Speaking of which, that should be your next order of business. Do the three required economic focuses and then ⟦2⟧. Afterwards, you should have enough ⟦3⟧ support to beeline straight down to ⟦4⟧. Start training additional Infantry divisions. Upgrade your economy law to when you can afford it.
All for One, One for All

As soon as ⟦0⟧ finishes, justify a War goal on ⟦1⟧. If the justification is going to take ~700 days, you should restart. You need pretty horrid luck for Atatürk to die this early (it should be between December 1937 and February 1938 right now), so it shouldn't happen again. After you join the ⟦2⟧, put your forces on the border with ⟦3⟧. Ideally, you should have ~15 divisions by now, with another ~6 or so on the way. Use your ⟦4⟧ to first grab the ⟦5⟧ for your Military Staff. Afterwards, focus on upgrading your conscription law and economy law when you can. Your next two focus goals should be first ⟦6⟧ in the army section of the focus tree and then ⟦7⟧ in the population section of the focus tree.

When your justification finishes, declare war on ⟦0⟧. Give your Field Marshal and General good traits using your ⟦1⟧ (Offensive Doctrine and Thorough Planner for the Field Marshal and Infantry Expert for the General). Call in your allies within a month or two (whenever you feel ready) and start pushing ⟦2⟧. You can just battle plan this. After ⟦3⟧ captitulates, take as much of the land bordering Hungary as possible. You should at least get 2 states, maybe 3 if the ⟦4⟧ aren't being jerks. It should be no later than July 1939 (probably much earlier). Begin to justify a War goal on ⟦5⟧. Throw a front line on the Soviet-Turkish border now and battle plan an offensive line deep in ⟦6⟧ and send it. This is to have your forces help the ⟦7⟧ capture ⟦8⟧ while your second justification is ongoing. Take Edirne in the peace deal for the achievement ⟦9⟧.

Send your forces to the Hungarian border but limit the frontline's size so that it is contained entirely in the states you control. Throw up an offensive line on the opposite side of Hungary, and when the justification finishes, declare war and send it. Make sure not to call in your allies this time. You should have ~24 divisions at this point, and you can just put your forces on Aggressive behavior even while they execute the battle plan. You'll win inside a month and get the achievement when you annex everything in the peace deal.
⟦0⟧ must be disabled for this strategy to work. Additionally, ⟦1⟧ is assumed to be enabled for this strategy, as it changes the Hungarian focus tree.
After the By Blood Alone update, it is not possible to join the ⟦0⟧ easily due to the distance penalty. However, it's still possible to get the achievement by joining the ⟦1⟧ through a focus.

Take focuses to become independent, hire a ⟦0⟧ advisor, change your ideology to ⟦1⟧, and take the ⟦2⟧ focus. This will allow you to join the ⟦3⟧ without worrying about the distance penalty. As soon as you turn ⟦4⟧, justify on ⟦5⟧ in order to bump the world tension past 20%. This lets you start on ⟦6⟧. (Once the World Tension is raised, cancel the justification. You don't ⟦7⟧ want to attack ⟦8⟧, and you don't want the ⟦9⟧/War support penalty that would hit you if you let a justification expire.) Optionally, create an intelligence agency, get the ⟦10⟧, put two spies in ⟦11⟧ and keep one building the spy network, the other promoting ideology. This is so that ⟦12⟧ stays below 30% ⟦13⟧ support and does not join the ⟦14⟧ when attacked.

Strip your infantry template down to 6 or 7 infantry battalions, build 15 of them, and put them on the border of ⟦0⟧ as soon as you're in the ⟦1⟧ (you can't have larger divisions at this point because of your manpower issues, and it's much easier to update the template on the spot than to build and ship newly trained divisions from Sydney to Odessa).

Justify war on ⟦0⟧ or ⟦1⟧, as they are both guaranteed only by ⟦2⟧. If you decide to invade Turkey, you can also get the ⟦3⟧ achievement if you occupy Edirne or take it in the peace deal. When you finish justifying, declare war and call in the ⟦4⟧, but also send in your own troops in to gain war score. When ⟦5⟧ is called in, attack them with your divisions, and you should be able to defeat them together with the ⟦6⟧ easily. In the peace deal, try to take provinces bordering Hungary, so you will be able to invade without calling the ⟦7⟧.

If the ⟦0⟧ manages to take everything, you can still use the paratrooper trick from the above strategy. You'll have to prepare in advance, though. Paradrop requires 70% air superiority, and you'll somehow need to amass enough fighters to counter Hungarian air force. 200 fighters might be enough. With zero beginning air tech except for transports and only 2 research slots, the best option is probably to license a fighter design from the ⟦1⟧ shortly after you join the ⟦2⟧ and start producing them ASAP. You'll also want to build an ⟦3⟧ next to the Hungarian border.

One major complication you have to deal with is that Australia has severely restricted manpower. You start the game with the conscription law capped at ⟦0⟧, which only gives you a maximum of 105K manpower. Unlocking higher conscription laws requires completing a long chain of focuses (you need to finish 3 70-day focuses - 210 days total - to unlock ⟦1⟧ and another 350 days to unlock ⟦2⟧). You want to finish ⟦3⟧ and switch to ⟦4⟧ at least a month before attacking {{flag|Romania, and you want to finish ⟦5⟧ and switch to ⟦6⟧ at least a month before attacking ⟦7⟧. If you rush everything and employ the justification on ⟦8⟧ trick, you should be able to declare on ⟦9⟧ in late 1939.

If you do everything quickly, you can invade ⟦0⟧/ ⟦1⟧ first (this is preferable to invading ⟦2⟧, because the war ends up shorter - on account of the ⟦3⟧ having a border with ⟦4⟧ - and you get a shot at ⟦5⟧.) But this only works if you start justifying before Atatürk retires or dies (usually sometime in mid- to late 1938, sometimes as early as January), because his replacement in historical AI, İsmet İnönü, has a trait "Justify war goal time on us +200.0%" (it will take you 600 days to justify), and if you declare before ~Feb 1939 (on historical, ⟦6⟧ drops its guarantee around that time).

Try to finish ⟦0⟧ before they take the ⟦1⟧ focus (on historical AI, in mid-1940; you should be able to see their focuses thanks your spy network), or you'll have a protracted fight against ⟦2⟧ instead of a quick and easy achievement.
⟦0⟧ must be disabled for this strategy to work.

This strategy gets early access to manpower by flipping to ⟦0⟧ via a civil war in order to get the Desperate Defense Subdoctrine. After that, we raise World Tension to 100% with repeated justifications on ⟦1⟧ and the ⟦2⟧ to enable us to join the Axis. We then use a small exploit to attack ⟦3⟧ from German territory without calling in ⟦4⟧ to ensure that we get all of the Hungarian territory in the peace deal.

The initial Focus order is ⟦0⟧ > ⟦1⟧ > ⟦2⟧ > ⟦3⟧ > [Wait 11 Days for autonomy to reach 550] >⟦4⟧ > ⟦5⟧. This sets us up for the civil war. In the meantime, spend your Political Power on hiring the ⟦6⟧, the Ban Communism decision after ⟦7⟧ finishes and the ⟦8⟧ after ⟦9⟧ is done. Use the ⟦10⟧ for the Proper Heritage ⟦11⟧. The freely editable cavalry templates are useful during the civil war and the invasion of ⟦12⟧. For your production put one ⟦13⟧ on trains, one on Artillery and the remaining ones on Infantry Equipment.

Now is a good time prepare any additional cheese you might want to use to make the civil war easier (e.g. deleting your starting army, creating a template containing one line anti-air battalion, putting as many as possible into training and then adding another anti-air battalion to the template to ensure that your opponent in the civil can't deploy any divisions by binding all of their manpower).

Click the Prepare for Civil War decision followed by Expand Civil Support once, save up 100 ⟦0⟧, and then wait for your ⟦1⟧ to drop below 60%. Then click Anti-Fascist Raids to reduce your ⟦2⟧ even further so you can ignite the civil war. Once in the civil war make sure to pick the Desperate Defense Subdoctrine and don't finish the civil war until after you have completed ⟦3⟧ and ⟦4⟧. You should also have enough ⟦5⟧ to switch to ⟦6⟧, but beware that your War support will drop once the civil war is over, so make sure you have enough ⟦7⟧ to send an attache to ⟦8⟧. From now on the exact foci you pick don't really matter, just prioritize research slots and industry.

During and after the civil war train 20 2-width cavalry divisions, get military access from ⟦0⟧ and ⟦1⟧ and send them to Venezia. Once they are in Europe convert them to a 20-width cavalry template with Support Artillery and start exercising them until the are fully trained. During this hire the ⟦2⟧ and start justifying on ⟦3⟧ and/or the ⟦4⟧ to increase World Tension. Keep canceling the justifications a couple of days before they finish, so you can keep doing them and avoid the penalties for expiring war goals. You won't be able to join the ⟦5⟧ until tension is at 100%. As soon as you are in the ⟦6⟧, start justifying on ⟦7⟧.

Put your division on a Front Line order on the German-Hungarian Border (Anschluss should have happened by now). When your war goal is ready, pause the game, order your divisions to walk into ⟦0⟧, click force attack and then declare on ⟦1⟧. Your Units should now be attacking into ⟦2⟧ without having to call in the Germans. Once you have taken your first tiles you can keep attacking from there. They should capitulate once you have taken Sopron, Győr, Pécs and Budapest. Depending on how long the civil war takes, how early you start justifying and how long it takes to beat ⟦3⟧ you should be done by late 1938 to mid 1939. You can also save time by not upgrading your Economy Law and instead get the ⟦4⟧ during the civil war so you can justify immediately. Just make sure to finish the civil war before World Tension reaches 50%, otherwise ⟦5⟧ ⟦6⟧ will be able to call the ⟦7⟧ into the civil war.
From here it is also relatively easy to wait for ⟦0⟧ to join the ⟦1⟧ and then justify on ⟦2⟧ for an attempt at ⟦3⟧.
